# Conker Goomba Road rough demo

Download **Conker-Goomba-Road-Demo.zip**, extract it, and open the `.z64` in Project64 using File → Open ROM. Create a new save file.

This is an early prototype. Village movement, Goomba Road battles, Pan, Shotgun, coins and XP were tested in Mupen64Plus. Project64 compatibility, shop transactions and the final boss have not yet been verified. The included build has a known sprite-facing issue.

Shotgun is under Pan in battle and costs 2 FP. Configure your controller under Project64's input settings.
